messages:
Alex Kim: Quick async pulse for today — SDKs / quickstarts / sample apps.
What I did: merged python quickstart updates, fixed a flaky example in the embeddings guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Blockers: bumped into CI flake on macos matrix (sporadic failures on docs build).\n\nMaria Gonzalez: Thanks Alex — saw the PR. Quickstart now installs with `pip install redwood-sdk==0.14.0` which I tested locally. :thumbsup:
I added a note about credential env vars and a tiny troubleshooting section.

Sam Patel: What about the node sample app? I ran it and got 502s from the local proxy. Looks like the default port collision with another dev service.
Today: I'll add a port override env and a small note in the README with the `PORT` example.

Jordan Li: @Sam can you drop the traceback? I think it's the proxy auth header we added last sprint. If you paste the network log I can triage.

Sam Patel: pasted snippet below:
```
Error: 502 Bad Gateway - connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:8080
    at TCPConnectWrap.afterConnect [as oncomplete] (net.js:1234:16)
```
Probable cause: example defaulting to 8080 while many devs run warp or other proxies there.

Lee Carter: For reviews: Alex's docs PR needs one more :eyes: — small nit in the curl example. Also, I started a tiny PR for the sample-app version matrix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/129
It lists tested combinations: node 18/20, python 3.10/3.11, sdk versions.

Alex Kim: Thanks Lee, will apply the curl fix today. @Jordan — could you review the auth header change? I want to ensure we call out the header in the quickstart (so folks don't miss it when swapping proxies).

Jordan Li: Yep will review after standup. Also adding a short blurb about `--no-tty` for CI runs where tty detection breaks streaming.

DevEx Bot: Deployed preview site for docs PR #842 to staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/changes/842 — build 1573

Maria Gonzalez: Blocker for me: getting test fixtures into the sample-apps repo. I need a tiny credential stub that doesn't hit prod — open to suggestions.

Lee Carter: We have a local fixture generator in infra-scripts. I'll extract a small subset into sample-apps/test-fixtures and make a PR today.

Sam Patel: Quick ask: can someone from Eng-runtime confirm that the SDK change (token header variation) is safe for older dedicated infra? @Alex or @Jordan?

Alex Kim: Confirmed — backward compatible. The server accepts both `authorization` and `Authorization` headers. I'll add a compatibility note.

Jordan Li: Approved doc PR locally, leaving one nit about escaping backticks. Will push review soon.

Alex Kim: Plan for today: fix curl example, add port override note to node README, merge Lee's matrix PR once CI green, follow up on macos docs CI flake with infra team.

Maria Gonzalez: I'll work on adding the troubleshooting snippet and the credential stub once Lee's PR lands.

Lee Carter: I'll open the test-fixtures PR in ~2 hours.

Sam Patel: I'll re-run node sample app after @Lee's PR and report back.

Alex Kim: Thanks all — ping here if you need a reviewer. :rocket:
